recent.text: The Mavericks are technically in first place via point differential tiebreaker because of Fred VanVleet’s 50-foot buzzer beater. They’re +17 to Denver’s +16 after that. But with Nuggets-Mavericks head-to-head matchup coming next week, it’s unlikely to matter.
recent.author: Bennett Durando
recent.quoted_text: The Nuggets beat the Rockets 133-124 in an NBA Cup group game with 32 lead changes and 17 ties. Nikola Jokic 26-7-11 (24 pts in second half) Christian Braun 19-5-3-4-1 Cam Johnson 19-3-6 Aaron Gordon 18-3-2 Denver and Dallas are tied for first place in West Group A at 2-0.

recent.quoted_text: May we all have the confidence of Reed Sheppard trying Trevon Brazile on a transition layup. TB swatted it. Bagley 3 on the other end. It's tied early 4Q.

recent.text: Jokic scored 18 points in the third quarter. He and VanVleet were trading blows. Rockets ended the frame on a 7-0 run to lead 102-99 entering key non-Jokic minutes to start the fourth.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Well that was an encouraging half for the Nuggets’ depth against a really good team. They lead Houston 62-60 despite Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray combining for 6 points on 2/8 FG. Christian Braun is their leading scorer with 12 points, 3 steals. Gordon/Johnson/DeRozan 9 each.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Nuggets went almost four minutes with an all-bench lineup against Alperen Sengun, Jabari Smith and Reed Sheppard for Houston … and Denver went +2 before subbing in a starter. DeRozan has 9 points. Marvin Bagley battling defensively against Sengun and using his fouls.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Nuggets got everyone involved in the starters’ first stint. Cam Johnson’s activity jumped out in particular, he went for 4-1-3-2 in his 7 minutes before being replaced by DeRozan.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Houston leads 19-17 at the first timeout. Rockets start 3-5 from 3. Denver's 2-4. Aaron Gordon got started at the line and hit a tough step-back jumper over Smith. Christian Braun with a couple of easy buckets early.
recent.author: Vinny Benedetto
